scope: Read-only study audit plus a narrow future-development inventory scanner fix; no model calls, rebuilds, treatment installation, frozen-record changes or tracker edits
conclusion: Current Original/D1 native R0 workflow is distinct from the not-yet-ready full eight-arm independent micro/puzzle/R2/D2 study. 164 focused tests pass, but known readiness and validity gaps remain.

findings.title: Eight-factorial design is not implemented
findings.detail: Supported designs are five_arm, refactor_pair and six_arm. README+alias, README+hint, and alias+hint factorial arms are absent. Config validation rejects an eight-arm design before a model call.
findings.action: Extend the shared condition schema, factor routing, context exposure and treatment matching once; add all-eight-arm positive/negative and resume tests before publishing a new freeze.

findings.title: Current API banks are not independent task banks
findings.detail: All seven current configurations point to absent integration_tasks files. The native R0 path does not use those files and can run legitimately without them. Independent condition evaluation requires a bound bank with complete micro coverage, at least one held-out puzzle, per-case oracle/reference/negative controls, and successful controls for every backend.
findings.action: Author and validate independent micro/puzzle tasks; freeze development and held-out partitions. Do not relabel native self-check acceptance as independent task correctness.

findings.title: Qualified README authoring still omits test examples and compiler comments
findings.detail: Qualified generation sets test_index={} even when repository tests exist. It only passes the selected definition description as source_doc. Current selected RDPro Java69/Scala261 and Thumbnailator225 ledger entries all lack description; Python descriptions are retained. This remains live code, not solely a frozen-D1 artifact.
findings.action: For a new authoring version, bind exact source-comment spans and reviewed exact-API test snippets. Preserve owner identity, constructor/setup dependencies and provenance; reject ambiguous bare-name matches. Keep frozen D1 untouched.

findings.title: README generation checks structure, not executable truth
findings.detail: find_or_create validates required sections and exact identities but does not execute each generated example. Correct APIs/signatures and a complete README do not establish that constructor, receiver, parameter and semantic advice is correct.
findings.action: Add bounded source-consistency checks plus isolated example build/run gates to future README artifacts. Report these as development validation, separate from independent task outcomes.

findings.title: Aliases can be installed without an equivalence receipt
findings.detail: Proposal checks enforce target/name/source boundaries and Python syntax. apply_treatments creates local commits with applied_unvalidated status. Condition freeze verifies added wrapper files, unchanged baseline code and task controls, but does not require per-alias forwarding/default/return/error equivalence tests.
findings.action: Require a hash-bound alias validation receipt covering representative valid, boundary/default and failing inputs before treating installation as accepted or launching the new alias ablation.

findings.title: Native hint editing is gated but does not cover every failure or library
findings.detail: Native hint path handles existing literal exception messages in Python/Java/Scala. Four distinct programs run on baseline/candidate. Unsupported/compiler/nonliteral/ambiguous failures remain evidence, not patches. Registered SQL lacks a reviewed implementation adapter. install_native_hints leaves an explicit checkout uncommitted; branch/commit/rebuild orchestration is separate.
findings.action: Publish a per-failure intake disposition and a supported-language matrix; prepare trusted controls/adapters, commit/rebuild the verified edits and bind the actual treatment source before evaluation.

findings.title: Development labels alone do not prove held-out independence
findings.detail: Native evidence intake verifies original R0 provenance and excludes supplied held-out IDs/APIs. Generic alias-log intake rejects explicit evaluation/held-out labels but permits unlabeled logs; condition bank checks disjoint IDs plus a nonempty holdout_review string. These checks do not prove semantic, fixture or answer independence.
findings.action: Freeze explicit development/evaluation manifests before treatment authoring; bind provenance and task/fixture partitions. Require a reviewed overlap audit, not only renamed case IDs.

findings.title: Native retry memory is not scoped by trial identity
findings.detail: R0 supplies no historical failures. At retry the native loop queries failures_for(API), which filters only function and fail/fixed status, not run/task/condition/version. Deterministic FIX_GUIDE advice also enters that log. The independent condition runner instead uses previous attempt feedback and native emitted hints without shared-log lookup.
findings.action: Do not just change max_fix_rounds to2. Use trial-scoped feedback or a declared frozen memory/advice policy, with isolation tests and recorded prompt exposure. This does not contaminate the current R0 loop.

findings.title: Existing D2 operator is same-bank R0 development revision
findings.detail: revise_readme_from_replay requires completed corrected replay, diagnoses failed D1 entries, and accepts examples after corrected native execution. It explicitly is not a D1/R2 deep dive or held-out correctness experiment. The matched comparison operator is Original/D1/D2 native R0 only.
findings.action: For the paper plan, drive D2 only from development failures after the declared repair policy, freeze D2, and conduct fresh held-out evaluation with matched tasks. Keep this existing operator labelled development.
